name: Forecasting weather and natural phenomena
gist: Building AI weather forecasters that blend physics knowledge with data to predict storms, climate, and environmental changes more accurately.
explain: Weather is driven by equations — the laws of fluid dynamics and thermodynamics. Current weather models solve those equations step by step on supercomputers. A five-day forecast takes hours to compute. Beyond ten days, the tiny uncertainties in the current state blow up and predictions become useless. Climate models try to project centuries into the future, but the compute and data requirements are staggering, and the models still have significant errors.

The bottleneck is that solving the equations is expensive. What if we trained a neural network on decades of past weather data and current observations to learn to predict the next day, or the next week, directly? A learned model could generate a forecast in seconds. The challenge is that weather obeys physics — storms do not just teleport — and a model trained only on data might learn fake patterns that work on test data but fail in the real world. It might predict a storm that violates conservation of energy, or forecast rain in dry air.

This cluster trains neural networks to forecast weather and climate, and deliberately infuses them with physics. Some networks are trained on historical weather data at global scale, learning to predict pressure, temperature, and precipitation days ahead without solving the equations. Others blend learned components with traditional physics solvers: use a fast learned model to do the bulk of the computation, then correct it with a physics-based step to ensure conservation laws hold. Still others use the learned model to improve initial conditions or to handle sub-grid phenomena (small-scale features too fine to resolve, like how clouds form in a single grid cell). The payoff is faster, more accurate forecasts and climate projections that respect physics because adding physics constraints prevents the model from predicting impossible storms or violating energy conservation.

papers.title: (Sparse) Attention to the Details: Preserving Spectral Fidelity in ML-based Weather Forecasting Models
papers.contribution: At 1.5° resolution matches or outperforms models trained on 0.25° data on IFS HRES with individual ensemble members exhibiting near-perfect spectral alignment across all resolved frequencies.

papers.title: DeepPrim: a Physics-Driven 3D Short-term Weather Forecaster via Primitive Equation Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves impressive short-term global and regional weather forecasting performance while demonstrating superior capacity to capture 3D atmospheric dynamics without relying on empirical simplifications.

papers.title: EMFormer: Efficient Multi-Scale Transformer for Accumulative Context Weather Forecasting
papers.contribution: The approach substantially improves long-term forecast accuracy and extreme event prediction, while demonstrating strong generalization on vision benchmarks (ImageNet-1K and ADE20K).

papers.title: GeoFAR: Geography-Informed Frequency-Aware Super-Resolution for Climate Data
papers.contribution: GeoFAR mitigates high-frequency prediction errors in both deterministic and generative SR models, achieving state-of-the-art performance across various spatial resolutions and downscaling ratios.

papers.title: Improving Extreme Wind Prediction with Frequency-Informed Learning
papers.contribution: The approach achieves significant improvements in extreme wind velocity prediction while maintaining robust overall performance.

papers.title: OmniField: Conditioned Neural Fields for Robust Multimodal Spatiotemporal Learning
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms eight multimodal spatiotemporal baselines in reconstruction, interpolation, forecasting, and cross-modal prediction with robustness to sensor noise.

papers.title: PnP-Corrector: A Universal Correction Framework for Coupled Spatiotemporal Forecasting
papers.contribution: On 300-day ocean-atmosphere forecast, reduces error 28% and surpasses state-of-the-art on key metrics.

papers.title: Structural Prognostic Event Modeling for Multimodal Cancer Survival Analysis
papers.contribution: Achieved 2.9% overall improvement on ten cancer benchmarks, outperforming existing methods in 8 out of 10 cohorts while maintaining robustness under missing genomic data.

papers.title: An Open-Ended Benchmark and Formal Framework for Adjuvant Research with MLLM
papers.contribution: Benchmarking 29 MLLMs shows OpenAI-o1 and DeepSeek-R1 achieve STS scores around 0.74-0.75, establishing a baseline for domain-specialized MLLM development.

papers.title: Benchmarking Physics-Informed Time-Series Models for Operational Global Station Weather Forecasting
papers.contribution: PhysicsFormer and other TSF models are benchmarked against operational systems across weather variables and extreme events, with WEATHER-5K, a large-scale observational dataset, supporting improved model training.

papers.title: BoreaRL: A Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Environment for Climate-Adaptive Boreal Forest Management
papers.contribution: Reveals carbon objectives are significantly easier than thaw objectives; naive approaches fail while strategic episode selection outperforms gradient-based methods.

papers.title: DGNet: Learning Spatiotemporal PDEs with Discrete Green Networks
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art accuracy across spatiotemporal PDE scenarios, maintaining stable performance on novel source terms where existing approaches collapse.

papers.title: LangPrecip: Language-Aware Multimodal Precipitation Nowcasting
papers.contribution: LangPrecip achieves over 60% and 19% relative gains in heavy-rainfall CSI at 80-minute lead time compared to vision-only SOTA on Swedish and MRMS benchmarks.

papers.title: Multimodal Scaling Laws for Task & Data-Optimized Models of Visual Cortex
papers.contribution: Establishes multimodal scaling laws showing pretraining saturation, complementary fine-tuning benefits, and log-linear mapping gains that generalize across recording modalities.

papers.title: SP-Mind: An Autonomous Reasoning Agent for Spatial Proteomics Analysis
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on SP-Bench (102 tasks across 18 categories) compared to existing open-source biomedical agent baselines.

papers.title: SPADA: A Verifiable Test-Driven Agent for Controllable Parametric CAD Assembly Generation
papers.contribution: The test-driven agent produces complex assemblies while maintaining geometric fidelity on a new human-validated benchmark of real-world code-centric assemblies.

papers.title: Scaling Laws of Global Weather Models
papers.contribution: Aurora exhibits strongest data-scaling (10x data→3.2x loss reduction) and reveals weather models favor increased width over depth, contrasting language model scaling behaviors.

papers.title: SpectraLLM: Uncovering the Ability of LLMs for Molecule Structure Elucidation from Multi-Spectra
papers.contribution: SpectraLLM achieves state-of-the-art performance substantially surpassing single-modality baselines and demonstrates strong robustness in unimodal settings.

papers.title: StormInsight: Hierarchical Environmental Forcing and Vertical Coupling for Weather System Evolution
papers.contribution: Reduces MAE by 12.4% and improves mCSI by 34.0% on StormBench; enables coherent 3D reconstruction of convective systems.

papers.title: SymSpectra: Symmetric Information Bottleneck Framework for Molecular Structure Recognition under Imbalanced Settings
papers.contribution: Achieves F1-score of 0.970 in substructure classification with strong robustness under various imbalance settings.

papers.title: TRIBE: TRImodal Brain Encoder for whole-brain fMRI response prediction
papers.contribution: Achieved first place in Algonauts 2025 brain encoding competition with significant margin, precisely modeling spatiotemporal fMRI responses to videos.

papers.title: TerraBind: Fast and Accurate Binding Affinity Prediction through Coarse Structural Representations
papers.contribution: Achieves 26× faster inference than state-of-the-art while improving binding affinity prediction accuracy by 16-20% on CASP16 and private datasets.

papers.title: TianQuan-S2S: A Subseasonal-to-Seasonal Global Weather Model via Incorporate Climatology State
papers.contribution: Significantly improves deterministic and ensemble forecasting over climate mean, traditional methods, and data-driven models including ECMWF-S2S.

papers.title: U-Cast: A Surprisingly Simple and Efficient Frontier Probabilistic AI Weather Forecaster
papers.contribution: Matches or exceeds GenCast and IFS ENS probabilistic skill while reducing training compute by 10x and inference latency by 10x.

papers.title: UrbanGraph: Physics-Informed Spatio-Temporal Dynamic Heterogeneous Graphs for Urban Microclimate Prediction
papers.contribution: UrbanGraph achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing FLOPs by 73.8% and increasing training speed by 21% compared to implicit graph learning approaches.
